metadata.name: slana
metadata.description: Slana: cute coin-themed on-chain Agar.io (identity, stakes, seasons, prizes)

instructions.name: capture_pass_entropy
docs: Permissionless: once the seed is public and the target slot has passed, stores the
entropy (hash of the first slot at or after the target) and the final seed, which
reveals the traits; re-targets if the target left the SlotHashes window.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Anyone; only pays the transaction fee.

accounts.name: claimer_token
docs: Receives the prize: a game-token account of the claimer.

instructions.name: close_pass_mint
docs: Ends the Pass mint for good and sets the trait entropy target slot.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The arena's token vault: holds every entry fee, signed for by the arena PDA.

accounts.name: next_season
docs: Season `config.current_season + 1`.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the config, the treasury and season vaults and season 1 for the game mint.
Only the program's upgrade authority may call it.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority (prevents front-running `initialize`).

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The game token. Validated by `token::validate_mint` (no freeze authority, no
forbidden Token-2022 extension) and stored in the config for good.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData account (PDA of the upgradeable loader, seeds `[program_id]`).

instructions.name: join_arena
docs: Pays the entry fee into the arena vault and opens a session (no Pass). Fails with
`FeeAboveLimit` if the fee rate fixed into the session exceeds `max_fee_bps` (the rate
the player was shown).

accounts.name: session
docs: One open session per player per arena: a second join fails because the PDA exists.

instructions.name: join_arena_with_pass
docs: Like `join_arena`, backed by a Slana Pass that is locked until the session closes.

accounts.name: pass_asset
docs: (owned by the Core program, owned by `player`, in `config.pass_collection`).

accounts.name: pass_lock
docs: Exists while the Pass backs an open session: a second join with the same Pass fails
with the System Program's "already in use" error (`PassInUse` in the SDK).

instructions.name: mint_pass
docs: Free mint of one Slana Pass (Core asset in the Pass collection) to the signer.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new Core asset (a fresh keypair).

accounts.name: collection
docs: `CollectionNotSet`); Core validates its contents during the CPI.

accounts.name: minter_token
docs: Game-token account of the minter; only needed when `config.pass_min_tokens > 0`.

accounts.name: pass_lock
docs: Required iff the session has a Pass: its lock, closed back to the player.

instructions.name: reveal_pass
docs: Publishes the Pass trait seed (checked against the committed hash), once, after the
mint ended, then sets the entropy target slot.

accounts.name: current_season
docs: `dup` so that `season_id == current_season` is reported as `InvalidSeason` by the
constraint above instead of a generic duplicate-account error.

instructions.name: set_pass_collection
docs: Sets the Pass collection once (a Core collection whose update authority is the
`pass_authority` PDA).

instructions.name: set_pass_seed_hash
docs: Commits `sha256(seed)` of the Pass trait seed (before the first mint).

instructions.name: settle_session
docs: Server-signed cash-out of a stake session.

accounts.name: server
docs: Receives the session's settle deposit.

accounts.name: player
docs: Pass lock rent).

accounts.name: player_token
docs: Any token account of the game mint owned by the player. The player creates and pays
for it (ruling R10: the server never pays a player's token account); without one the
server waits, and the 24 h self-refund returns the entry fee only.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: Writable: the burn share lowers its supply.

accounts.name: pass_lock
docs: Required iff the session has a Pass: its lock, closed back to the player.

types.name: Arena
docs: A stake arena tier. PDA `["arena", id.to_le_bytes()]`.
Entry fees are held in the arena's token vault `["vault", arena]` (authority = this PDA).

fields.name: entry_fee
docs: Entry fee in base units of the game token.

fields.name: requires_pass
docs: Only Slana Pass holders may join.

fields.name: max_sessions
docs: Maximum number of simultaneously open sessions.

fields.name: vault
docs: The arena's token vault.

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration. PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: May change the configuration, create arenas, manage seasons and withdraw the treasury.

fields.name: server_authority
docs: Game server key that signs `settle_session`.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The game token ($SLANA). Written once and never changed.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Token program owning `token_mint` (SPL Token or Token-2022).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee charged on stake profit, in basis points (≤ `MAX_FEE_BPS`).

fields.name: pass_fee_bps
docs: Fee charged on stake profit of a Pass session (≤ `fee_bps`).

fields.name: treasury_bps
docs: Shares of each fee: treasury vault, season vault, burned. They sum to `BPS`.

fields.name: settle_fee_lamports
docs: Lamports a player deposits per session to pay the server's settle transaction
(≤ `MAX_SETTLE_FEE_LAMPORTS`).

fields.name: current_season
docs: Id of the season that is currently running.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new arena joins (settlements and refunds keep working).

fields.name: pass_collection
docs: Metaplex Core collection of the Pass (`Pubkey::default()` = not set yet).

fields.name: pass_base_uri
docs: Base URI of Pass metadata (`pass_base_uri[..pass_base_uri_len]`, zero padded).

fields.name: pass_supply
docs: Maximum number of Passes (≤ `MAX_PASS_SUPPLY`, ≥ `pass_minted`).

fields.name: pass_minted
docs: Passes minted so far.

fields.name: pass_per_wallet
docs: Free mints per wallet (≤ `MAX_PASS_PER_WALLET`).

fields.name: pass_min_tokens
docs: Minimum game-token balance needed to mint (0 = no requirement).

fields.name: pass_mint_opened
docs: The mint has been opened at least once: `pass_supply` is frozen from then on.

fields.name: pass_mint_ended
docs: The mint ended for good (`close_pass_mint`, or the last Pass of the supply was minted).
It never reopens; `reveal_pass` may publish the seed from then on.

fields.name: pass_seed_hash
docs: `sha256(pass_seed)` committed before the first mint.

fields.name: pass_seed
docs: The admin's seed, public once `pass_seed_revealed` (zero before).

fields.name: pass_revealed
docs: The traits are public: `capture_pass_entropy` stored `pass_final_seed`.

fields.name: pass_seed_revealed
docs: `reveal_pass` published `pass_seed` (checked against `pass_seed_hash`) and set the
entropy target slot. The seed is public before any entropy target exists.

fields.name: pass_entropy_target_slot
docs: Set by `reveal_pass` (after the seed is public): `slot + ENTROPY_DELAY_SLOTS`, moved
forward again if nobody captured it while it was in the SlotHashes window. 0 before.

fields.name: pass_entropy_captured
docs: `pass_entropy` holds the captured hash.

fields.name: pass_entropy
docs: Hash of the first slot at or after the target slot, stored by the permissionless
`capture_pass_entropy` (zero before): a chain value nobody, the admin included, can
know or choose when the mint ends.

fields.name: pass_entropy_slot
docs: Slot of `pass_entropy`.

fields.name: pass_final_seed
docs: `sha256(pass_seed || pass_entropy)`, set by `capture_pass_entropy` (zero before). The
single seed every Pass trait is derived from (`passTraits(final_seed, n, supply)`).

types.name: LeaderEntry
docs: One row of a season leaderboard.

fields.name: best_score
docs: Best single-game score of this player during the season.

types.name: MintCounter
docs: Number of Passes a wallet minted. PDA `["pass_minted", minter]`.

types.name: PassEntropyCaptured
docs: `capture_pass_entropy` stored the trait entropy.

fields.name: slot
docs: Slot whose hash is the entropy (the first slot with a block at or after the target).

types.name: PassEntropyRetargeted
docs: The target slot left the SlotHashes window before anyone captured it: a new future target.

types.name: PassLock
docs: Lock of a Pass asset while it backs an open session, so one Pass backs at most one
session at a time (even across transfers). PDA `["pass_lock", asset]`.
Paid by the player at join and closed back to them at settlement or refund.

types.name: PassMintEnded
docs: The Pass mint ended for good (closed by the admin or sold out). Next: `reveal_pass`.

fields.name: number
docs: 1-based Pass number (`Slana Pass #<number>`).

types.name: PassRevealed
docs: `capture_pass_entropy` stored the entropy and the final seed: the traits are public.

fields.name: seed
docs: The admin's committed seed (`sha256(seed) == pass_seed_hash`).

fields.name: final_seed
docs: `sha256(seed || entropy)`: the seed every Pass trait is derived from.

types.name: PassSeedRevealed
docs: `reveal_pass` published the seed and set the entropy target slot.

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: On-chain player identity and statistics. PDA `["profile", owner]`.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 name bytes, zero padded; only `name[..name_len]` is meaningful.

fields.name: skin
docs: Equipped skin id (`< BASIC_SKINS`).

fields.name: season
docs: Season that `season_points` belongs to.

types.name: Season
docs: A season with its top-20 leaderboard. PDA `["season", id.to_le_bytes()]`.
Prize tokens live in the global season vault (`["season_vault"]`); `pool` is this
season's share of it. While the season runs, settle fee shares, sweeps and rollovers add
to `pool`; `end_season` freezes it into `prize_pool`; each claim takes its prize out of
`pool`, and `rollover_season` moves what is left into the then-current season.

fields.name: prize_pool
docs: Prize pool frozen by `end_season`.

fields.name: pool
docs: Game tokens of the season vault that belong to this season and are not paid out yet.

fields.name: claimed_mask
docs: Bit `rank` set ⇔ the prize of that rank was claimed.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of used leaderboard entries.

fields.name: entries
docs: Sorted by `points`, descending; only `entries[..count]` are meaningful.

types.name: Session
docs: An open stake session (one per player per arena). PDA `["session", arena, player]`.
Its lamport balance is its rent plus `settle_fee`, both paid by the player at join: the
deposit goes to the server at settlement (it pays the settle transaction), the rent back to
the player. A refund returns both to the player.

fields.name: id
docs: `Config::total_sessions` at join (PDAs are reused, ids are not).

fields.name: entry_fee
docs: Entry fee paid into the arena vault, in base units of the game token.

fields.name: has_pass
docs: Joined with a Slana Pass: lower fee, season points, and `pass_asset` is locked.

fields.name: pass_asset
docs: The Pass asset backing the session (`Pubkey::default()` without a Pass).

fields.name: settle_fee
docs: Settle deposit in lamports (`Config::settle_fee_lamports` at join).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee on profit in basis points, fixed at join (`Config::pass_fee_bps` with a Pass,
else `Config::fee_bps`): later fee changes never touch an open session.

fields.name: burned
docs: Part of `fee` that was burned.

fields.name: session_id
docs: `Session::id` the server is settling. Session PDAs are reused when a player joins
the same arena again, so this stops a delayed/retried settlement of an old session
from being applied to a newer one at the same address.

fields.name: payout
docs: Game-token base units the player cashed out with (taken from the arena vault, before
the fee on profit).

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Every `Some` field replaces the stored value; `None` keeps it. The token mint is fixed
at `initialize` and cannot be changed.

fields.name: split
docs: `[treasury_bps, season_bps, burn_bps]`, must sum to `BPS`. (An array rather than a
tuple because the Anchor IDL has no tuple type; the Borsh encoding is identical.)

fields.name: pass_base_uri
docs: At most `MAX_BASE_URI_LEN` bytes, ends with `/`; frozen once the first Pass is minted.

fields.name: pass_supply
docs: `1..=MAX_PASS_SUPPLY`; frozen once the mint has opened (`SupplyLocked`).

fields.name: pass_per_wallet
docs: `1..=MAX_PASS_PER_WALLET`.

fields.name: pass_mint_open
docs: `true` opens the mint (never after it ended). `false` closes it only while no Pass is
minted; a started mint ends with `close_pass_mint` (`UseCloseMint`).

constants.name: ARENA_SEED
docs: `Arena` PDA: `["arena", id.to_le_bytes() (u16)]`.

constants.name: BASIC_SKINS
docs: Number of basic skins (ids `0..BASIC_SKINS`); every player may use all of them.

constants.name: BPS
docs: Basis-point denominator (100 %).

constants.name: CLAIM_WINDOW_SECS
docs: Season prizes can be claimed for this many seconds after the season ended (30 days).

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: `Config` PDA: `["config"]`.

constants.name: DEFAULT_PASS_PER_WALLET
docs: `Config::pass_per_wallet` set by `initialize`.

constants.name: DEFAULT_PASS_SUPPLY
docs: `Config::pass_supply` set by `initialize`.

constants.name: ENTROPY_DELAY_SLOTS
docs: Slots between the end of the Pass mint and the slot whose hash becomes the trait entropy
(~1 minute at 400 ms). Whoever ends the mint cannot know that future hash.

constants.name: FIRST_SEASON
docs: Id of the first season (created by `initialize`).

constants.name: LEADERBOARD_SIZE
docs: Number of entries kept on each season leaderboard.

constants.name: MAX_ARENA_SESSIONS
docs: Maximum value of `Arena::max_sessions`.

constants.name: MAX_BASE_URI_LEN
docs: Maximum length of `Config::pass_base_uri` in bytes.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Upper bound for `Config::fee_bps` (10 %); `pass_fee_bps` must not exceed `fee_bps`.

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LEN
docs: Maximum player name length in bytes (UTF-8).

constants.name: MAX_PASS_PER_WALLET
docs: Upper bound for `Config::pass_per_wallet`.

constants.name: MAX_PASS_SUPPLY
docs: Upper bound for `Config::pass_supply`.

constants.name: MAX_SCORE_PER_GAME
docs: Score of a single game is clamped to this value.

constants.name: MAX_SETTLE_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: Upper bound for `Config::settle_fee_lamports` (the per-session settle deposit).

constants.name: MAX_XP_PER_GAME
docs: XP granted by a single game is clamped to this value.

constants.name: MIN_ARENA_SESSIONS
docs: Minimum value of `Arena::max_sessions`.

constants.name: PASS_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Data-less signer PDA that is the update authority of the Pass collection: `["pass_authority"]`.

constants.name: PASS_LOCK_SEED
docs: Lock of a Pass asset while it backs an open session: `["pass_lock", asset]`.

constants.name: PASS_MINTED_SEED
docs: Per-wallet Pass mint counter: `["pass_minted", wallet]`.

constants.name: PRIZE_RANKS
docs: Number of leaderboard ranks that receive a season prize.

constants.name: PRIZE_SHARES_BPS
docs: Prize share of each season rank in basis points (sums to 10 000).

constants.name: PROFILE_SEED
docs: `PlayerProfile` PDA: `["profile", owner]`.

constants.name: SEASON_SEED
docs: `Season` PDA: `["season", id.to_le_bytes() (u32)]`.

constants.name: SEASON_VAULT_SEED
docs: Global season prize token vault (authority = the config PDA): `["season_vault"]`.

constants.name: SESSION_REFUND_TIMEOUT_SECS
docs: A session that was never settled can be refunded by its player after this many seconds (24 h).

constants.name: SESSION_SEED
docs: `Session` PDA: `["session", arena, player]`.

constants.name: TREASURY_VAULT_SEED
docs: Treasury token vault (authority = the config PDA): `["treasury_vault"]`.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Token vault of an arena (authority = the arena PDA): `["vault", arena]`.

constants.name: XP_LEVEL_DIVISOR
docs: `level = 1 + isqrt(xp / XP_LEVEL_DIVISOR)`.
